This is a petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. for quashing of FIR No.267/2021, under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC, registered at Police Station Gazipur, Delhi, and all proceedings emanating therefrom.
2.

The brief facts of the case are that the petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 got married on 10.12.2017 according to Hindu rites and ceremonies and they lived together as wife and husband with each other.
After the marriage, the disputes and differences arose between them and they started living separately since 16.11.2020.
On 23.06.2021, the respondent No.2 got the above said FIR registered against the petitioners.

sentences.text: The copy of the decree is already on record.
4. Petitioners and Respondent No.2 are present in Court and they have been identified by the IO.
I have interacted with the parties and they submit that they have settled their disputes.
Respondent No.2 admits that she has settled the matter amicably with the petitioners.
She further submits that the settlement/compromise has taken place voluntarily, without any force, pressure or coercion.
As per settlement, today, a demand draft of Rs. 2,00,000/- (bearing no. 102176 dated 17.10.2023 drawn on State Bank of India) has been handed over to respondent no.2.
Respondent No.2 submits that nothing remains to be adjudicated further between them and she has no objection if the FIR in question is quashed.
Statement of respondent no. 2 in this regard has been recorded separately.
5. Learned APP for the State submits that in view of the settlement, the State has no objection if the FIR in question is quashed.
6. Keeping in view the above facts and circumstances, since the matter has been amicably settled between the parties, no useful purpose will be served by keeping the case pending.

sentences.text: On S.A. I am respondent no. 2 in the present case.

On 10.12.2017, I got married to the petitioner no.
1, namely, Shri Prakash Singh Rawat, S/o Shri Meharban Singh Rawat, R/o E-44/B, Boop Singh Colony, Rajpur Khurd, Chattarpur, New Delhi-110068 as per the Hindu rites and customs.

Due to some temperamental issues, differences and disputes arose between me and petitioner no.1,
thereafter, I started living separately since 16.11.2020.

I admit that I have settled the matter amicably with the petitioners voluntarily, without any force, pressure or coercion in terms of the Settlement Agreement dated 05.01.2023 arrived before the Mediation Centre, Karkardooma Courts.

My marriage with the petitioner no. 1 has been dissolved vide decree of divorce dated 08.05.2023,
